$comment: Machine tools `kit tools` installs at these pins, each optional: the kit's hooks skip quietly without them. `release` is the checksum-verified GitHub release download used on every OS that has an asset; `install` is the package command otherwise. {pin} is replaced by the pin.

rtk.why: Compresses shell output before it reaches the agent; core's rtk-rewrite hook calls it.
rtk.manual: download the asset for this OS from https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/releases/tag/v{pin} and put the rtk binary on PATH
knownIssues: A different tool also publishes as 'rtk' (Rust Type Kit), including the crates.io `rtk` crate. If `rtk gain` fails you have the wrong binary.

codegraph.why: Code knowledge graph for symbol and impact questions; core's codegraph hooks and skill use it where a repo has an index.
knownIssues: On Windows npm cannot replace codegraph while a Claude Code session runs its MCP server (EPERM): close those sessions, then run kit tools again.

fallow.why: Dead-code, duplication and doc-freshness audits for a JavaScript or TypeScript repo.
